Example Transatlantic Award

The Example Trust supports school leavers who want to go on to university.

Eligibility

Applicants need A-levels AAA, IB 39 points, or SAT ≥ 1450.

Benefits

Selected students receive GBP 4,000 a year.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload your documents before the closing date. Shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview with the selection panel, and the results are announced on this page.
